title: SINGULARITY
summary: Agentic deep-search and research platform with multi-agent orchestration and citation-grounded outputs at under a 10% hallucination rate.
highlights: BYOK inference supporting Gemini, xAI and DeepSeek
Real-time SSE streaming with chat over research reports
Sliding-window rate limiting, JWT + Google OAuth
ARQ workers with orphan job recovery on startup
Full Docker stack on AWS at $7 effective monthly cost

title: ineedajob.pro
summary: AI job-application intelligence platform with structured LLM pipelines, resume-grounded tailoring, company research and a Chrome extension.
highlights: BYOK inference across Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, xAI and DeepSeek
JobLens pipeline: profile synthesis, JD breakdown, match scoring
Typed structured outputs everywhere via Pydantic response models
Cover letter engine with Regular, Storyline, Disruptive and Custom modes
Hopper Chrome extension for ATS detection and resume form-filling

title: Snap2Caption
summary: End-to-end MLOps platform built around a LLaVA image-captioning model, covering training, deployment, storage and feedback.
highlights: Fine-tuned LLaVA with LoRA/QLoRA for caption generation
Run and artifact tracking with MLflow, object storage on MinIO
Provisioned with Terraform, Ansible, Kubespray and Helm

title: SMOLSolver
summary: Generator-verifier-ranker framework testing whether small models can beat majority vote at selecting correct math reasoning answers.
highlights: Inspired by the rStar paper on small-model reasoning
Compared learned verifier and ranker against majority vote
Studied narrow-task tuning over general-purpose scaling
